title: NGS Library Prep Size Selection Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather consumables and hardware
steps.instruction: Collect all required items: Eppendorf twin.tec 96‑well PCR plate (150 µL, catalog #0030128605), Opentrons magnetic module, Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tuberack with 4 × 6 insert for 2 mL Eppendorf snap‑cap tubes (or equivalent), Opentrons 10 µL and 200 µL filter tip racks, Opentrons GEN1 P10 and P300 single‑channel electronic pipettes.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the 4 × 6 tuberack with 2 mL snap‑cap tubes in slot 2 of the OT‑2 deck. Load tube A1 with SPRI beads, tubes B1‑B3 with 80 % ethanol, and tube C1 with Low‑EDTA TE buffer.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, input the number of samples to process, the bead‑mix volume (µL), bead‑mix speed (µL/s), bead‑mix repetitions, and the mount sides for the P10 and P300 single‑channel pipettes.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Generate and download the protocol script from the Opentrons App.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file back into the Opentrons App.

steps.title: Set up deck per map
steps.instruction: Confirm that the deck is arranged exactly as described in the deck map (matching the layout in step 2).

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the P10 and P300 pipettes. Refer to the support articles for calibration tip usage if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons App to start the size‑selection procedure.
